label: Figure 25.1: A free-trade area
alt: Countries A, B and C linked by two-way free-trade arrows inside a shaded free-trade area; outside country D faces a complete embargo from A, tariffs from B and free trade with C.
caption: Countries A, B and C trade freely with one another, but each sets its own policy towards outsider D: A bans trade with D completely (embargo), B taxes D’s goods with tariffs, and C trades freely with D. There is no common external policy.
